items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Faulkner wrote a book called Intruder in the Dust, and he knew my grandfather.

ctx.x: 1918. Dorothy’s dug all this up. She’s seen all the records, talked to the people down there. All the white people whose children, their progeny, knew about it, you know, cause they heard about it. And Faulkner wrote a book called Intruder in the Dust, and he knew my grandfather. But this loose is not about my grandfather, but he tried to base it somehow off of that. But anyway, Faulkner lived around there. But anyway, what I’m trying to tell you is that my grandfather was a - Yes dear, you need something?
